I'm p4 with $249 cash. I just left jail and landed on Community Chest. All three yellows are mortgaged.

Unmortgage costs $143 for each yellow. I can afford one. I will unmortgage a property.

I am considering trading for cash instead. p1 has $1758 and already offered $200 for the yellows.

I cannot trade away the yellows. They are my only win path, and I have no other assets to offer in exchange. p1 has no use for them either. I am now reconsidering whether to mortgage one of the yellows.

I will end the turn. Nothing is mortgageable, so I cannot unmortgage or sell the yellows. I need to keep my cash for survival.
